text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to read and analyse written words. Another common application is translation, where tools like Google Translate change text from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which means identifying whether a piece of writing expresses positive, negative, or neutral feelings. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and providing helpful information. Thanks to NLP, our daily interaction with technology is becoming easier and more natural.
